title: Notifications
lead: Reminders even with the app closed, sent by your notification server. It only gets times, texts and which quests are done: never weight, food or workouts.
serverHint: Your Render service address, e.g. https://diario-fitness-push.onrender.com
registerKeyHint: The server's REGISTER_KEY: needed only the first time, not saved.
unsupported: This browser doesn't support push notifications. On Android use Chrome with the app installed.
rulesHint: They only arrive when the quest is planned that day and not done yet.

errors.network: Server unreachable. Render's free service can take a minute to wake up: try again.
errors.denied: Permission denied: allow notifications for this app in Android settings.
errors.not_configured: The server has no VAPID keys yet.
errors.rate_limited: Too many tries: wait a little.
errors.subscription_gone: The browser dropped the subscription: turn notifications on again.
errors.not_found: The server no longer knows this phone: turn notifications on again.

text.stepsBody: Target {label}: one walk and you're there.
text.dietBody: Tick today's meals in the menu.
text.streakBody: You still have {label} quests to close today.
